sections.title: Advanced Chemical Kinetics and Reactor Design
sections.description: Mechanisms of chemical reactions. Transition state theory. Langmuir-Hinshelwood Kenetics. Absorption and cataysis. Simple and complex reaction schemes. Design of idealized reactors. Fluidized reactors. Solid-gas reactions. Residence time distributions. Reaction and diffusion in solid catalysts. Reactor stability and control.
